subject: DPA: retention carveouts & verification language
messages:
From: Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@asterhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-06T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Questions on retention carveouts and verification

Marissa — thanks for sending the redline. A few points our legal team flagged while reviewing the retention/deletion sections (section 4.2/4.3):

1) We need explicit language that backups and cold snapshots are included in the "delete upon request" obligation or — if excluded — an explicit schedule for permanent deletion.
2) Your proposed verification step says Redwood will provide "reasonable evidence" of deletion. Can you clarify what types of evidence you can provide and the SLA for producing them? Our auditors require written certification within 30 days for customer-initiated erasure.
3) For onshore processing we are asking for a carveout allowing local access for support in emergency incidents; can that be narrowed to named engineers and approved jumpboxes?

We attached markups for your convenience. Can we get a quick confirmation on the above items by EOD tomorrow?

— Tom
Legal, Aster Health

Attachment: redline_from_Aster.docx (docx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@asterhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-06T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on retention carveouts and verification

Tom — thanks, got your notes and redline. Quick read-through and answers below; we'll follow up with a consolidated redline and evidence matrix.

1) Backups/snapshots: Our policy is to include backups in the customer erasure workflow, but we do have a staged process — immediate logical deletion + scheduled physical purge (default 30 days from request) to avoid data corruption for other tenants. We can shorten that window to 7 days for Aster as part of the contract if required; note this will affect operational restore guarantees.

2) Verification: We can provide a deletion certificate signed by our security officer, logs showing erase job invocation, and a snapshot of the wipe job report (hashes of objects removed). We can commit to delivering that package within 30 days; if you need 15 days we can try to commit for Dedicated customers with a support SLA add-on.

3) Support access carveout: We agree to limit emergency onshore access to named engineers and pre-approved jumpbox hosts. We'll propose adding a schedule and an access log requirement, plus a two-person approval flow.

I'll loop in Ben and Laura to translate into the DPA redline and add the evidence matrix. Expect a consolidated response and updated doc by tomorrow midday.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Privacy Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-06T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on retention carveouts and verification

Marissa — notes from ops/security follow-up below, pulling into the proposed language:

- Backups: default flow is logical object tombstone + background GC. We can add an optional clause: "For named customers, physical purge of backups will be executed within X days upon request; customer may elect expedited purge at additional cost." Suggested X = 7 days for Aster.

- Evidence: We can produce the following artifacts: deletion job id(s), job run logs (timestamped), storage lifecycle event records, and a signed PDF certificate from our CISO. For encrypted backups where key revocation is used as proof of access termination, we will provide key rotation proof and KMS audit logs.

- Onshore support access: propose text that limits access to an approved roster of up to 4 engineers, requires a documented emergency justification, records the session (transcript + jumpbox IP), and requires post-incident notification to the customer within 48 hours.

I'll draft redline snippets and attach the evidence matrix mapping each ask to artifacts we can produce. Neha — can you confirm whether we can commit to a 30-day cert SLA for hosted customers and 15 days for Dedicated?

— Ben
Senior Director, Customer Reliability

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-07T09:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on retention carveouts and verification

Ben — confirmed from Security: 30 days is our standard for hosted; 15 days for Dedicated is possible with a Priority Evidence SLA (will require an internal runbook and a $XXk annual support uplift). For the 7-day backup purge window, ops flagged that some storage providers require a 48-hour minimum retention for immutable snapshots; we can still promise "commence purge" within 7 days, completion may be 7-14 days depending on underlying vendor constraints.

Also: for the certificate, we will standardize on a signed PDF with job ids and S3/object paths redacted except for hashes; we will not disclose other tenants' paths. That should be acceptable for auditors.

Neha
Director, Product Security

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@asterhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-07T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on retention carveouts and verification

Tom — attaching an updated DPA excerpt and evidence matrix that reflect our commitments below:

Key proposed concessions:
- Backups/snapshots: Redwood will "commence physical purge" of customer backups within 7 days of an erasure request and complete purge within 14 days subject to third-party provider constraints; customer may opt into a Dedicated expedited purge (complete within 15 days).
- Verification: Redwood will produce a Deletion Certificate (signed by CISO), deletion job ids and run logs, KMS audit log extracts (if key revocation used), and a redacted purge report. Standard turn-around: 30 days for Hosted; 15 days for Dedicated with Evidence SLA.
- Onshore support access: limited to an approved list of up to 4 engineers, access only via pre-approved jumpbox hosts, recorded sessions, two-person approval for any emergency access, and notification to customer within 48 hours.

We also added language that enumerates what constitutes "reasonable evidence" versus what we cannot provide (raw tenant paths, live full-disk images).

Attachment: DPA_Redlines_v3.docx (docx), evidence_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

Can you confirm the above is acceptable or flag items you still need changed? If you confirm, we'll incorporate and prepare an executed addendum.

Best,
Marissa

From: Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@asterhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@asterhealth.com
Date: 2028-06-09T16:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on retention carveouts and verification

Marissa — appreciate the thoroughness and the evidence matrix; that addresses most of our concerns. Two remaining asks before we route to procurement: 

1) Can you change the "commence purge within 7 days" phrasing to "complete purge within 14 days" for Hosted customers (auditors don't like the word "commence").
2) For the Deletion Certificate, can we have a standardized template example included in the evidence matrix (even redacted) so procurement can review?

If you can accept #1 and drop a sample cert in the matrix, we should be able to move to signature.

— Tom

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@asterhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-09T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on retention carveouts and verification

Tom — yes, we can update the Hosted language to "complete purge within 14 days" (we'll retain the note about vendor constraints in the playbook). I've attached a redacted sample Deletion Certificate to the evidence matrix (hashes only, no tenant paths). I'll push the change to DPA_Redlines_v4 and send full package to legal and procurement this afternoon.

Thanks — Marissa
Head of Privacy Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachment: DPA_Redlines_v4.docx (docx), evidence_matrix_with_sample_cert.xlsx (xlsx)
